notes: iRacing: the track map and the racing line coach are now switched on in the stable version too - until now they were only in the beta. iRacing does not tell apps where your car is on track, so PitWise works it out from your heading and speed: the map draws itself over your first full lap, and after a couple of clean laps the coach shows your best line and gives corner tips. Everything else is exactly the same as in 2.29.0. This part has only had a short beta test, so if the map or the coach does something odd in iRacing, please use the feedback form in the app.
